scope: Actual React UI and controlled IPC; no live model, native window or downloaded data
workPackage: WP-W03 / Agent decision and task confirmation
checks: All questions require actual options or custom text
Answers bind to the selected conversation and question IDs
Choice answers are preferences, never execution approval
Pending choices block dependent planning and confirmation
Changed choices require a fresh or revised review
Answers and reviewed task context survive history restoration
Explicit native automatic permission skips questions and confirmation
Failed answer saves retain the pending decision
An oversized review never exposes an incomplete confirmation or corrupts history
Task cards show the request, answers, native file scope, dates, output and limits
Vector acquisition retains request and choice context
Selected options have distinct border and background colors
limitations: Controlled UI and native tests are not a live model or original-data download acceptance
No installer was packaged or published
Unified TaskRequest, batch execution and aggregate task completion remain future implementation
